Run this from the project root:

```
node --test tests/cart.test.ts
```

I ran it just now and both cart tests passed (2 of 2).

To run a single test by name, add `--test-name-pattern`:

```
node --test --test-name-pattern="discount" tests/cart.test.ts
```

`npm test` runs every file in `tests/`, so it won't give you just the cart tests.

Next: paste the first command into your terminal.
